stem: Assume we observe the data 𝑥1 =9, 𝑥2 =7, 𝑥3 =8, 𝑥4 =10, 𝑥5 =6 sampled from the geometric distribution 𝒢⁡(𝑝). Find the maximum likelihood estimate for 𝑝. (Write the answer in decimal)

solution.reason: For G(p) on {1,2,...}, the MLE is 1/x̄ = n/Σxᵢ. Here Σxᵢ=40 and n=5, so p̂=5/40=0.125.

solution.choice_text: \(\tilde\Theta\) is better as it has smaller MSE
solution.reason: A smaller MSE means a smaller expected squared estimation error; 0.5 is less than 1.
